Sunetra Pawar-led NCP Wins All 21 Seats in Sugar Factory Election

The Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) faction led by Sunetra Pawar has won all 21 seats in the Someshwar Sugar Factory election. This victory is seen as a boost to her influence in the Baramati region.
